topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Discovering the novel was a peculiar moment, certainly. There I was, sifting through the clutter of old notebooks and stacks of paper, when it caught my eye. The title was simple, my name sprawled across the cover in a familiar scrawl. I flipped through the pages, each one filled with carefully crafted scenes, moments of our life spun into narrative threads. It wasn’t just a story; it was our story, or at least his version of it. I felt a strange mix of emotions, but mostly, I felt seen. It’s a strange thing, to be the subject of someone’s creative endeavor, a silent observer to the private thoughts they’ve woven about you.
